# Deploy to Streamlit in Snowflake

Generated by SAShiny 0.0.0 (CONTRACT.md 6.8.5). Replace every `<...>` placeholder.

The app runs the SAShiny Streamlit front end on a Streamlit in Snowflake container runtime. The
runtime cannot install Java, so it reaches SAS Viya over HTTPS only. Packages are installed from
PyPI through the Snowflake artifact repository `snowflake.snowpark.pypi_shared_repository`; your
role needs `GRANT DATABASE ROLE SNOWFLAKE.PYPI_REPOSITORY_USER TO ROLE <role>`.

The app reaches SAS at these host:port pairs; `snowflake/setup.sql` allows them in a network rule:

- viya.example.com:443

## 1. Create the objects

```sh
snow sql -f snowflake/setup.sql
```

## 2. Store the SAS credentials

Copy `snowflake/secret.sql`, replace the placeholders in the copy, run it, then delete the copy:

```sh
snow sql -f <copy-of-secret.sql>
```

## 3. Upload the app and create it

```sh
snow stage copy bundle @SASHINY_DB.APP.SASHINY_STAGE/app --recursive --overwrite
snow sql -f snowflake/streamlit.sql
```

Open the app in Snowsight under Projects > Streamlit, or with `snow streamlit get-url SASHINY_STREAMLIT`.
